## Summary

Field report from brillo on 0.26.0: init refused to install the prepare-commit-msg hook because core.hooksPath was set — to the repo's own /Users/jins/IO/brillo/.git/hooks, so the message claimed .git/hooks was inert when it was the live hooks dir, and attribution was unavailable for no reason. The check tested only whether the value existed, never what it resolved to. Fixed by resolving it: effectiveHooksDir in core/attribution.ts asks `git config --get core.hooksPath` (the value can arrive from the global scope or an include, so parsing .git/config would miss it, and that spawn is why it is not in core/git.ts), resolves relative values against the working-tree top, and reports the raw value. init installs when the path resolves to <common>/hooks by realpath and skips only when it genuinely names somewhere else — husky and lefthook directories are TRACKED in the user's repo, so writing there would add a committed file — and the skip now names that directory's prepare-commit-msg and the exact line. doctor shares the resolver, or a working hand-installed husky hook reads as attribution off. Both shapes reproduced live on the fixed build: brillo's config installs, .husky skips with an actionable message and nothing written. Suite 1657 green, 0.26.1 built.
